name: Posco Dx Company Ltd.
summary: Posco Dx Company Ltd. provides ICT solutions to construction and materials industry in South Korea and internationally. The company offers technologies in various fields, such as self-learning, IoT, cloud, big data and AI, etc. It offers smart factory; factory automation; software development; and sales and engineering services. The company also provides PosFrame, a smart platform that collects structured and unstructured data in real-time from production site to utilize the data-based analytics and AI to enable optimum process control.
